segments.label: PQC-SecOC-HS-v1. A = sender build, TCP client; B = receiver build, TCP listener. A: fresh ML-KEM-768 key pair per attempt; M1: no signature, no MAC
B on M1 (at most one per T_min): ID_A must equal SHA-256 of B's one pinned peer public key; B signs role byte 'R' || transcript hash th2 (SHA-384)
B: HKDF (HMAC-SHA-256) gives four keys: kc-r, kc-i = key-confirmation keys; auth-i2r, auth-r2i = session MAC keys. B installs nothing yet (T_pend)
A on M2: ID_B must equal the key id of A's one pinned peer key; sig_B is verified BEFORE the decapsulation key dk is used; decapsulation erases dk
A: same HKDF (ss erased right after HKDF-Extract); key-confirmation tag mac_B checked; sig_A over role byte 'I' || th3; tag mac_A, then kc-i erased
A cut-over: SecOC_TxSessionHold(TRUE), SecOC authenticates no further session PDU; M3 once SecOC_TxSessionFlushed() (bound: T_flush)
A installs when M3 is handed to the TCP socket: MAC keys auth-i2r, auth-r2i; signature context "PQC-SecOC-PDU-v1" || sess; freshness counters reset
B on M3: the stream behind M3 is gated; sig_A and mac_A are checked; B installs when SecOC has drained, then sends M4 and reopens the stream
A on M4: M4 only ends A's attempt; kc-r is erased. No valid M4 within T_A: a new handshake starts; the installed keys stay

messages.label: CSM_JOBID_KEM_KEYGEN -> ek
messages.note: Csm_CustomService: ML-KEM-768 key generation. ek = encapsulation key; dk stays in the Csm.

messages.label: M1, 1217 bytes: ver || ID_A || ek
messages.note: 1 + 32 + 1184 bytes, plus the 8-byte SoAd PDU header (also M2..M4). ID_A = SHA-256 of A's ML-DSA-65 public key. A waits for M2 at most T_A.

messages.label: CSM_JOBID_KEM_ENCAPS -> ct
messages.note: Csm_CustomService: ML-KEM-768 encapsulation to ek. The shared secret ss stays in the Csm.

messages.label: Csm_SignatureGenerate -> sig_B
messages.note: ML-DSA-65 over role byte 'R' || th2. PqcHs itself computes th2 = SHA-384(L || M1 || ver || ID_B || ct), with L = "PQC-SecOC-HS-v1".

messages.label: CSM_JOBID_HS_KDF -> 4 keys
messages.note: HKDF: salt th2, input ss. ss is erased right after HKDF-Extract.

messages.label: Csm_MacGenerate -> mac_B
messages.note: Key-confirmation tag: HMAC-SHA-256 with kc-r over a transcript hash.

messages.label: M2, 4462 bytes: ver || ID_B || ct || sig_B || mac_B
messages.note: 1 + 32 + 1088 + 3309 + 32 bytes. The four keys stay pending in PqcHs and are wiped if T_pend expires.

messages.label: Csm_SignatureVerify sig_B
messages.note: ML-DSA-65 over 'R' || th2 with the pinned public key of B. A forged M2 is discarded and changes nothing.

messages.label: CSM_JOBID_KEM_DECAPS (ct)
messages.note: Csm_CustomService: ML-KEM-768 decapsulation of ct. ss stays in the Csm; dk is erased in the same call.

messages.label: CSM_JOBID_HS_KDF -> 4 keys
messages.note: Same HKDF as on B. ss is erased right after HKDF-Extract.

messages.label: Csm_MacVerify mac_B
messages.note: HMAC-SHA-256 with kc-r. A wrong tag ends the attempt.

messages.label: Csm_SignatureGenerate -> sig_A
messages.note: ML-DSA-65 over role byte 'I' || th3. PqcHs itself computes th3 = SHA-384(L || M1 || M2).

messages.label: Csm_MacGenerate -> mac_A
messages.note: HMAC-SHA-256 with kc-i; PqcHs then erases kc-i.

messages.label: M3, 3342 bytes: ver || sig_A || mac_A
messages.note: 1 + 3309 + 32 bytes. SoAd on B parses nothing behind M3 until PqcHs calls SoAd_RxGateRelease.

messages.label: PqcHs_Install, no wait for M4
messages.note: On TxConfirmation(M3) = E_OK. Csm_KeyElementSet: auth-i2r = Tx key, auth-r2i = Rx key (MAC variant of SecOC); context of the PDU signatures. FVM_SessionInstall: Tx counters of the session streams. Then SecOC_TxSessionHold(FALSE). sess = SHA-384(L || M1 || M2 || M3).

messages.label: Csm_SignatureVerify sig_A
messages.note: ML-DSA-65 over 'I' || th3 with the pinned public key of A.

messages.label: Csm_MacVerify mac_A
messages.note: HMAC-SHA-256 with kc-i; PqcHs then erases kc-i and waits until SecOC_RxSessionDrained() is TRUE.

messages.label: PqcHs_Install, before M4
messages.note: As on A, with Tx key auth-r2i and Rx key auth-i2r; Rx freshness counters of the session streams reset.

messages.label: Csm_MacGenerate -> mac_ack
messages.note: Key-confirmation tag: HMAC-SHA-256 with kc-r over sess (session hash).

messages.label: M4, 33 bytes: ver || mac_ack
messages.note: 1 + 32 bytes. B then erases kc-r and calls SoAd_RxGateRelease: the stream behind M3 is parsed again.

messages.label: Csm_MacVerify mac_ack
messages.note: Valid: the attempt ends with PQCHS_RESULT_OK; kc-r is erased. A wrong mac_ack is only discarded.

cards.title: When each side switches
items: A: PqcHs_Install when TxConfirmation(M3) is E_OK (M3 handed to the TCP socket); A does not wait for M4.
B: PqcHs_Install after sig_A and mac_A are valid and SecOC_RxSessionDrained() is TRUE; then M4, then SoAd_RxGateRelease.

cards.title: What PqcHs_Install writes
items: auth-i2r and auth-r2i as Tx / Rx MAC keys of the MAC variant of SecOC.
"PQC-SecOC-PDU-v1" || sess as context of the PDU signatures.
FVM_SessionInstall: freshness counters of the session streams reset.

cards.title: Erasure
items: dk: inside the decapsulation call. dk and ss never leave the Csm.
Key-confirmation keys: kc-i after mac_A; kc-r after mac_ack (B) or after M4 (A).

cards.title: Transport
items: M1..M4 use the TCP connection of the Secured I-PDUs.
Each message is one SoAd PDU with an 8-byte PDU header; the sizes on the drawing are without it.
